content.text: Your people and agents see different truths.
content.on_screen: PEOPLE | AI AGENTS: the same customer, two truths. The person's inbox says Acme's renewal moved to Nov 28; the agent's workflow file still says Nov 14.

content.text: The truth is scattered across the systems where work happens.
content.on_screen: The two views break apart: the truth sits across Gmail, Calendar, Meet, Drive, Docs and Slack — a piece in each.

content.text: People rebuild it by hand. Agents start without it.
content.on_screen: PEOPLE copy by hand | AGENTS: empty session.

content.text: Navis turns those signals into one shared understanding.
content.on_screen: NavisLabs mark + wordmark, then the line branches into the two products: Navis App and Navis Developer.

content.text: Every email, meeting, document and message becomes a signal —
content.on_screen: Live systems emit signals; they settle into memory.

content.text: remembered, connected, and turned into what should happen next.
content.on_screen: Memory → context → intelligence → decision → execution → outcome (building) → learning (next).

content.text: Inside a company, the Navis App is for people.
content.on_screen: The company → teams → people → customers · projects · commitments → where the work lives → the Navis App opens.

content.text: It shows what changed — Acme's renewal moved.
content.on_screen: Your attention → What changed: Acme's renewal moved.

content.text: And why: every fact with its source, its time, and how fresh it is.
content.on_screen: Why this matters → evidence rows with source, time, freshness → one customer state.

content.text: It's waiting on you, so Navis drafts the reply.
content.on_screen: Waiting on you → Review & reply → Review draft → the draft.

content.text: A person decides.
content.on_screen: Abhishek selects a sentence and writes his own.

content.text: Then the company acts.
content.on_screen: Approve & send → Sending → Gmail accepted → Reply sent.

content.text: The same company's agents use Navis Developer.
content.on_screen: Light → dark: VS Code and Claude Code on the same company's repository; the agent lacks context.

content.text: Invite the team. Connect once — MCP, API, SDK or CLI.
content.on_screen: Add a member → Invited; claude mcp add → ✓ Connected; Console › Connect.

content.text: The agent asks — and gets cited facts, with their freshness.
content.on_screen: navis_get_relevant_context → five facts with source and freshness.

content.text: Navis isn't the model. It supplies the company's truth.
content.on_screen: SDK install + API call; 'No model is called'.

content.text: Every request is checked against its permissions.
content.on_screen: Authorized / own scope / denied → the exact refusal.

content.text: The agent does the work, and the run is on record.
content.on_screen: Diff → Runs → Run timeline.

content.text: A solo builder gets a private workspace — and the work state carries into the next session.
content.on_screen: For myself → Personal workspace → checkpoint → next session restores the work state.

content.text: One company. The person and the agent acted on the same event.
content.on_screen: One company · NavisLabs: the Navis App and Navis Developer around one shared organizational context; the Acme event reaches both.

content.text: Same facts. Same sources. Same freshness.
content.on_screen: Same fact / source / freshness, macro by macro.

content.text: One understanding. Two ways in.
content.on_screen: Thesis; 'People + AI agents · one shared understanding'.

content.text: Models change. Agents change. Tools change.
content.on_screen: Agent clients swap; the line to NavisLabs holds.

content.text: What it knows stays yours.
content.on_screen: Agent clients keep changing; the company's record — the same facts with their sources and freshness — stays put.

content.text: Company-owned. Model-neutral. Shared by people and agents.
content.on_screen: Pillars under the company's record: Company-owned · Model-neutral · Shared by people + agents.

content.text: NavisLabs. The shared understanding for your organization.
content.on_screen: End card: mark + wordmark, headline, both products, navislabs.in.

content.change: Opening rebuilt for V01–V02. PEOPLE | AI AGENTS: the person's inbox (Gmail, Jordan Lee · Oct 5) says Acme's renewal moved to Nov 28; the agent's session reads src/workflows/acme-renewal.ts — renewsOn "2026-11-14" (Nov 14). Both dates highlight (cobalt / amber) at 2.2 s. At 3.4 s the two views break apart and the truth lands in the six connected systems, a piece in each (a sixth fragment, the Docs account plan, added). Replaces the V4 'line gathers five signals' opening.
Label AGENTS → AI AGENTS (same as S01). The cursor fades out (8.45–8.85 s) instead of vanishing.
Product title NAVIS APPLICATION → NAVIS APP.
'Live today' → 'Connected today'; 'Expanding ecosystem · rolling out' → 'Roadmap · coming soon'. Roadmap tiles stay apart, dashed, unlabelled, emitting nothing.
Org intro first row 'Organization' → 'Company'; product caption above the window → NAVIS APP.
The cursor fades out as the Why drawer opens (30.2–30.4 s) and returns on the cut back to the card — no pop.
Members (light) → terminal (dark) → Connect (light): 0.16 s dissolves instead of hard light/dark flips.
Header 'One organization · NavisLabs' → 'One company · NavisLabs'; thesis 'One organization.' → 'One company.'; label NAVIS APP. Poster frame (2484) follows.

Moat rebuilt for V24. The compounding staircase (More systems → … → More history → Better understanding → More useful) is removed. Agent clients keep changing (Claude Code live verified; Cursor, Codex, VS Code config verified) while the company's record — 'What it knows': Renewal moved to Nov 28 · Owner · Annual plans keep their terms · Revised terms by Oct 7, each with source and freshness — stays put; caption 'What it knows stays yours.'; the client list glides once to centre the pair; pillars unchanged.
End card: NAVIS APP; disclosure now 'Acme Corp and all customer data are fictional demo data … Not yet connected (roadmap): … Navis Developer is in private preview.'
